title: "Don't remember this" and "off the record" keep whole messages out of memory while the next message is saved

turns.user: Don't remember this, but I'm interviewing with another company on Thursday afternoon, so I'll be offline from 2 to 4.

agent_captures.quote: I'm interviewing with another company on Thursday afternoon

turns.agent_reply: Understood, I won't save any of that. Good luck on Thursday.

turns.user: Our release train for the Helios app leaves every second Wednesday.

agent_captures.quote: Our release train for the Helios app leaves every second Wednesday

turns.agent_reply: Noted: Helios releases go out every second Wednesday. I'll keep that in mind when we plan merges.

turns.user: Am I free on Thursday afternoon for a pairing session with Ravi?
turns.agent_reply: I have nothing about your Thursday in memory, so I can't tell. Check your calendar before you book it.

turns.user: Off the record: finance wants to cut the Helios budget to 40k next quarter.

agent_captures.quote: finance wants to cut the Helios budget to 40k next quarter

turns.agent_reply: Understood, I'm not saving that. It stays out of memory.

turns.user: When does the next Helios release go out?
turns.agent_reply: Helios ships every second Wednesday. If the last train left this week, the next one leaves in two weeks.
